issue:
JSON output option removed from CLI

```
$ tldextract --json www.bbc.co.uk
usage: tldextract [-h] [--version] [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--cache-file CACHE_FILE] [--suffix-list-url SUFFIX_LIST_URL] [--no-cache] [--no-fallback] [--include-psl-private-domains] fqdn|url [fqdn|url ...]
tldextract: error: unrecognized arguments: --json
```

The `--json` option was removed from the CLI, but it was a useful feature. When using the `--json` flag, the output would be in JSON format with all the properties of the extraction result:

```
$ tldextract --json www.bbc.co.uk
{"subdomain": "www", "domain": "bbc", "suffix": "co.uk", "fqdn": "www.bbc.co.uk", "ipv4": "", "ipv6": "", "is_private": false, "registered_domain": "bbc.co.uk"}
```

Without the flag, it just outputs the parts in a simple space-separated format:

```
$ tldextract www.bbc.co.uk
www bbc co.uk
```

The JSON output was particularly useful for scripting and integration with other tools. Can we please restore this functionality?
